cause: Every five-second presence anchor reran instantaneous glyph overlap suppression. Active canonical cars disappeared and later returned farther along their unchanged source routes.
fix: Commit the previous canonical vehicle ID preference in DemoCity. In tiled_game only, preserve still-active previous members through later overlaps; suppress overlapping new entrants. Selected newcomers retain priority, explicit seeks and semantic/provider changes reset preference, absent source rows are never synthesized.

method.browser: real headed Chromium via existing Playwright
method.recording: 900 samples at 100 ms over 90 seconds, tracking every discovered canonical vehicle ID through the actual retained shader attributes
method.position: Float32 shader interpolation reconstructed from actual instance buffers and shader clock; no GPU readback or optical-flow claim
method.sameIdJumpRule: While opacity >= 0.5 at both adjacent samples, flag displacement > max(2 metres, 25 metres/second * shader-clock delta)
method.opaqueRemovalRule: Canonical ID absent in next sample after prior opacity >= 0.99
method.opaqueReappearanceRule: Previously seen canonical ID returns after absence, with prior and new opacity > 0.9
method.sourceClassification: Replay getPresence for each removed canonical driver at the captured five-second anchor and compare its current position with committed viewport bounds; replay and recorded bounds match exactly

existingUserTabBeforeFix.interpretation: Confirms continuous motion for this one existing-tab car; does not exclude membership churn or verify the refreshed user tab.

failFirst: DemoCity replaced the existing fixture car at +5 seconds when an overlapping lower-hash newcomer arrived
Two already displayed crossing cars became one at the next anchor

limitations: This is a bounded 90-second local camera run; no citywide, mobile, 16x or public acceptance is inferred.
RequestAnimationFrame intervals are not a measurement of completed map render frames or GPU throughput.
Existing cars may visually overlap; this patch does not implement traffic collision simulation or change source speeds/routes.
Viewport exits and provider trip completion intentionally remove cars; fresh entries and completed once-route cycles remain source-driven.
The long-lived user IAB still needs its separate post-refresh acceptance; no claim of full graphics acceptance or cloud publication.
